items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Well, right now the name doesn't ring a bell, but possibly if I saw him it might be a recreational memory.

ctx.x: Bass player? I don't think so.
It doesn't ring a bell. He's from here originally and he plays around Los Angeles. He plays with lots of people including Kidwardy. Hillbilly Band. I think the Cowboy Band.
Well, right now the name doesn't ring a bell, but possibly if I saw him it might be a recreational memory. Sure.
